{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_numeric'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_mask = (sales['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99)
num_qa = qa_mask.sum()

# Filter to completed orders
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Remove QA orders from completed orders
completed_clean = completed_orders[~qa_mask]

# Compute conversion rate by customer_segment
conversion_rates = completed_clean.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean() * 100

# Get the segment with highest conversion rate
best_segment = conversion_rates.idxmax()
best_rate = conversion_rates.max()

# Print all required numbers
print("Number of QA orders:", num_qa)
print("Total completed orders after QA removal:", len(completed_clean))
print("Conversion rates by segment (in percent):")
print(conversion_rates)
print(f"Best segment: {best_segment} ({best_rate:.2f}%)")"}
